title: Credential Lifecycle — Issuance
description: Half of the credential-lifecycle conformance pair. A holder requests a conformance credential and an authority issues it to their wallet. Deliberately minimal: this blueprint exists to produce a credential whose status can then be driven through every state the two status-list specifications define, so anything not needed to issue a credential is left out.
author: Sorcha Team

template.title: Credential Lifecycle — Issuance
template.description: Issues the credential that the conformance suite then suspends, reinstates and revokes. Two actions and two participants, because a credential-issuing action needs a prior action to draw its claims from and a recipient to address.

participants.name: Credential Holder
participants.description: Requests the credential and receives it into their wallet. The subject of every lifecycle operation the conformance run performs.

participants.name: Issuing Authority
participants.description: Issues the credential and owns its status. Only the original issuer may suspend, reinstate or revoke, so every lifecycle call in the conformance run authenticates as this participant.

actions.title: Request Credential
actions.description: Holder requests a conformance credential, supplying the subject details the credential will carry. Starting action.

subjectReference.title: Subject reference
subjectReference.description: Unique per conformance run, so a run never matches a credential an earlier run issued.

routes.description: Request recorded — route to the authority to issue

actions.title: Issue Credential
actions.description: Authority issues the conformance credential to the holder's wallet. The credential binds to a status list at issuance — that binding is what every later suspend, reinstate and revoke acts on, and its absence is why a credential issued before the issuer had lists cannot be driven through the lifecycle at all.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: A disclosable claim, so the conformance run can exercise selective disclosure alongside the status lifecycle.
